question: For the NXT title that had the shortest match (excluding titles with "title change"), what were the names of the two wrestlers involved?
sql:
-- Final answer: NXT Championship shortest match (title_change=0) with wrestlers
SELECT b.name as belt_name, m.duration, w1.name as winner_name, w2.name as loser_name
FROM Matches m
JOIN Belts b ON m.title_id = CAST(b.id AS TEXT)
JOIN Wrestlers w1 ON m.winner_id = w1.id
JOIN Wrestlers w2 ON m.loser_id = w2.id
WHERE b.name = 'NXT Championship' AND m.title_change = 0 AND m.duration != ''
ORDER BY CAST(SUBSTR(m.duration, 1, INSTR(m.duration, ':') - 1) AS INTEGER) * 60 + CAST(SUBSTR(m.duration, INSTR(m.duration, ':') + 1) AS INTEGER) ASC
LIMIT 1
